on-redline.purpose: Label colour on Redline/Redline Hot fills only (primary CTA, ::selection text); large text only (19px/700, ~4.4:1 on Redline, ~3.7:1 on Redline Hot).

shade.purpose: Shading tone only, never a surface: bike contact shadow (.88 to .45), equipment floor ellipse and menu-sheet shadow (.8), equipment drop shadow (.7), opaque stop in mask-image gradients.

specular.purpose: The single soft-light highlight in the one-pass sweep across the bike, masked to its alpha.

display.purpose: Three-line hero H1 only; size is the per-breakpoint --h1 clamp.

lead-in.purpose: The headline's first beat in silver, 0.36 x H1; part of the headline group, not a label.

numeral.purpose: Gear readout digit in its fixed rolling window.

button.purpose: Primary and ghost CTA labels; 19px bold keeps white-on-red at large-text contrast.

label.purpose: Nav links at 15px; smaller steps are label-md and label-sm.

body.purpose: Hero description, max 40ch; fluid to body-lg on >=1024.

title-sm.purpose: Gear caption title in the flat laptop plate (>=1280 wide, <=820 tall).

label-sm.purpose: Gear labels on phones <480 and in the flat plate; gear instrument label.

body-lg.purpose: Top endpoint of the fluid desktop description, clamp(15px, 1.15vw, 17px).

shadows.name: bike-contact
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under the bike on the floor line.

shadows.name: product-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter on equipment cutouts only, seating them on the floor.

shadows.name: menu-sheet
shadows.purpose: Mobile menu sheet over the page.

shadows.name: red-glow
shadows.purpose: The scene's single red light source behind the bike.

shadows.name: specular-sweep
shadows.value: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 38%, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 50%, transparent 62%); mix-blend-mode: soft-light
shadows.purpose: One-pass light sweep across the bike, masked to its alpha.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: All movement: entrances, underlines, gear indicator, focus pull.

motion.name: ease-color
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background fades on controls.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: ky-rise 1000ms expo-out; from opacity 0, translateY(18px); delay calc(var(--d) - var(--intro-shift))

motion.name: headline-line-up
motion.value: ky-line-up 1100ms expo-out from translateY(108%) inside an overflow mask; 90ms stagger

motion.name: intro-shift
motion.value: 0ms first visit; 780ms when intro already seen this session
motion.purpose: Pulls the whole choreography forward on repeat visits.

motion.name: focus-pull
motion.value: 700ms expo-out; bike -> opacity .3, scale .965, blur 5px (blur only >=1024); product in from opacity 0, y 28px, scale .94, blur 10px; out to y -12px, scale 1.02, blur 8px
motion.purpose: Gear change racks focus from machine to equipment.

motion.name: gear-indicator
motion.purpose: Red bar sliding along the gear track.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: spring stiffness 55, damping 18, mass .9; bike 12/7px, glow -36/-18px

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 1ms, no intro curtain, no specular sweep

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Night Garage"**

One machine stands in a single pool of light on wet asphalt; everything else is obsidian. The page is a campaign one-sheet, not a storefront: a huge, tight condensed headline on the left, the motorcycle on the right, and an instrument-panel gear indicator that racks focus from machine to equipment. Density is low and deliberate; the dark does most of the work.

The material vocabulary is motorsport hardware: hairline silver rules at low alpha, square-cornered plates, a faint carbon weave behind the copy, one red rim light. Red is a signal, never a fill colour for the world. Motion is exponential ease-out throughout, so everything arrives fast and settles slowly, like a throttle blip.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian ground with a single red rim light and a deep vignette toward the copy column.
Barlow Condensed set huge and tight for display; Manrope for running text.
Square corners everywhere; structure drawn with 1px hairlines, not boxes or shadows.
Red reserved for a short, enumerated list of signals.
A gear-indicator selector (N/1/2/3) as the signature interaction, with a focus-pull between bike and equipment.
Expo-out motion and a staggered CSS entrance choreography.

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Red appears only in the enumerated signal roles above. If a new element wants red, it must replace one of those signals, not join them.

rules.name: The Single Light Rule
rules.body: The scene has one red light source (the glow behind the bike and its floor rim). Do not add second coloured light sources or gradients in other hues.

rules.name: The Display Does the Talking Rule
rules.body: Every non-sentence string (buttons, nav, numerals, labels) is Barlow Condensed in capitals with positive tracking; every sentence is Manrope in sentence case. Never mix within a role.

rules.name: The Scale With H1 Rule
rules.body: Headline-adjacent display text derives from `--h1` rather than its own fixed size, so the headline group keeps its proportions at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Lit Scene Rule
rules.body: Controls and plates never cast shadows; only physical objects in the scene (bike, equipment) and the overlay sheet carry depth.

dos: **Do** keep red in its enumerated signal roles (active gear, primary CTA, one headline line, strip micro-accent, KATALOG hover, intro line, selection).
**Do** draw structure with 1px Hairline rules and keep every corner square.
**Do** set every non-sentence string in Barlow Condensed capitals and every sentence in Manrope.
**Do** derive headline-group sizes from `--h1` and re-clamp `--h1` per breakpoint.
**Do** use expo-out easing for movement and let focus (blur, dim, scale) express state changes in the scene.
**Do** keep text layouts stable during state changes (stacked captions in one cell, fixed numeral window).
donts: **Don't** add rounded corners, pill buttons or soft cards; the world is square-cut hardware.
**Don't** put shadows on controls or plates; depth belongs to the scene's objects.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a second coloured light source.
**Don't** treat the italic typographic wordmark as the logo or derive an emblem from it; it is a placeholder until the official logo arrives.
**Don't** add small tracked labels above headings; the lead-in is part of the headline at 0.36×H1, and the "UZATMA" label belongs only to the gear instrument.
